title: Cisco Webex Message
description: Represents a message posted in a Webex room, including text, markdown, files, and adaptive card attachments.

parentId.description: The parent message ID if this is a threaded reply.

roomId.description: The room ID where the message was posted.

text.description: The plain text content of the message.

markdown.description: The message content in markdown format.

html.description: The rendered HTML content of the message.

files.description: Public URLs for files attached to the message.

personId.description: The person ID of the message author.

personEmail.description: The email address of the message author.

mentionedPeople.description: Person IDs of those mentioned in the message.

mentionedGroups.description: Group names mentioned in the message.

attachments.description: Adaptive card attachments on the message.

contentType.description: The content type of the attachment.

isVoiceClip.description: Whether the message is a voice clip.

created.description: The date and time the message was created.

updated.description: The date and time the message was last updated.
